{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
data['biomarker_final'] = data['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute response rate by sex
response_by_sex = data.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Compute the difference in response rates (female - male)
response_diff = response_by_sex['F'] - response_by_sex['M']

# Print the exact numbers used in evidence
print("Response rate, female:", response_by_sex['F'])
print("Response rate, male:", response_by_sex['M'])
print("Difference (F - M):", response_diff)

# Also print the raw counts to verify
print("\nResponse counts by sex:")
print(data.groupby(['sex', 'responded']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
